title: Culture of IMR90 Cells in Advanced MEM with Reduced Serum
protocol: Remove 20 mL from a new bottle of Advanced MEM (AMEM) basal medium and discard.
Add 10 mL of fetal bovine serum (FBS) to the remaining AMEM in the bottle.
Add 10 mL of GlutaMAX to the AMEM in the bottle.
Add 1 mL of 100X penicillin/streptomycin to the AMEM in the bottle.
Mix thoroughly and label with the date and additives.
Warm growth medium to 37 °C and prepare materials prior to obtaining a vial of cells from cryostorage.
Remove vial from liquid nitrogen (wearing eye protection) and thaw in 37 °C water bath (1-2 min).
Add 24 mL of growth medium to a 50 mL conical tube.
Transfer thawed cells from the cryovial into the growth medium using a P1000 pipette.
Invert the tube gently 10 times to mix the cells and medium.
Pellet cells via centrifugation at 1,000 x g for 4 minutes at room temperature in a centrifuge with a swinging bucket rotor.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant.
Gently resuspend the cells in 12 mL of pre-warmed growth medium.
Add 13 mL of additional growth medium to the cell suspension.
Transfer the cell suspension into a collagen-coated 15 cm dish.
Distribute the cell suspension on the dish through gentle rocking and swirling for approximately 15 seconds.
Place the dish in a tissue culture incubator overnight.
Check cells the following day for attachment to the dish.
Aspirate and replace the medium.
Pre-warm growth medium and DPBS in a 37 °C water bath for approximately 30 minutes.
Aspirate the growth medium from plates to be passaged.
Rinse cells with pre-warmed DPBS and swirl gently for approximately five seconds.
Aspirate the DPBS wash.
Add trypsin and rotate gently to distribute evenly across the plate.
Place in tissue culture incubator for 4 minutes, then use the palm of your hand to gently tap the side of the dish to facilitate detachment.
Add 12 mL growth medium and gently wash the surface of the dish with a pipette to break up large cell clumps.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 50 mL conical tube.
Wash the dish again with an additional 12 mL of growth medium, collect, tritrate, and add to the cell suspension from Step #7.
Pellet cells at 1,000 x g for 4 minutes at room temperature in a centrifuge with a swinging bucket rotor.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 12 mL of growth medium.
Triturate at least four times to thoroughly break up clumped cells.
Mix thoroughly by inverting the tube 10 times.
Calculate the cell concentration in the cell suspension.
Determine the new culture APD.
Calculate and record the number of cells obtained per plate during this passage.
Calculate the number of population doublings that occurred during the last passage and add that number to the previous APD.
Dilute cells to 4.0 x 10^4 cells/mL in growth medium in a 50 mL tube or larger sterile bottle based on needed volume.
Mix thoroughly by inverting 10 times.
Dispense the diluted cell suspension into each dish.
Distribute cell suspension on the dish through a combination of gentle rocking and swirling for approximately 15 seconds.
Place bottles of growth medium and DPBS in a 5% CO₂ incubator with lids partially unscrewed for 15 minutes to adjust pH before returning to 4°C for storage.
Prepare freezing medium by mixing 50% FBS, 40% growth medium, and 10% DMSO.
Filter the freezing medium through a 0.2 μm pore syringe filter into a 50 mL conical tube.
Determine the number of cells present and pellet cells at 1,000 x g for 4 minutes at room temperature in a centrifuge with a swinging bucket rotor.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in freezing medium at a density of 1.25 x 10^6 cells/mL.
Mix cell suspension by gently inverting 10 times and dispense 1 mL aliquots into cryovials using a P1000 pipette.
Transfer the frozen vials in liquid nitrogen storage.
